Our Purpose

Objective

ILBSL aims to empower Nepal’s underserved communities by fostering self-reliance and independence.

Vision

To build a sustainable and inclusive society by promoting economic independence among Nepal’s marginalized populations.

Mission

To provide sustainable microfinance services to needy and underserved families across Nepal.

Goals

  • Empower Deprived Households: Reach maximum households using technology-driven solutions.
  • Institutional Excellence: Build a well-managed organization with motivated staff.
  • Formalize the Informal Financial Sector: Educate individuals outside the banking system.
  • Support Entrepreneurship: Assist marginalized individuals in establishing SMEs.
